provenance: MA-4 AC-2 hysteresis. A non-qualifying tick (prob back in-band, >= floor) mid-count resets the recovery ladder to 0 and the position STAYS armed; a subsequent recovery must re-count from 0 (no chatter). Edge case from plan Edge Cases.

sequence.note: prob back in-band (8.0 >= 5.0) -> non-qualifying -> ladder reset to 0, stays armed
recovery resumes -> re-counts from 0, NOT from 1
